Regeneration: Heals all missing wounds at end of turn.
Frenzy: Re-roll missed Attack Rolls in the first round of combat. Can't flee from charges.
Reanimated: -1 Movement. Never flees: loses D3 wounds instead of taking a break test. Can't flee from charges.
Demonic: Never flees: loses D3 wounds instead of taking a break test. Can't flee from charges.
Ambusher: Deploys anywhere on your half of the battlefield, up to 2" from the centre line.
Halberd: Charge Bonus: +1 Power. Damage Saves against this weapon are never better than 4+.
